findings.title: Stream-to-sink backpressure silently drops events
findings.description: Under sustained event load, _schedule_stream_sink_publish drops events when _stream_sink_publish_tasks reaches max_pending_tasks=512. Only signal is a metric counter; no alarm rule observed.
findings.recommendation: Two-part: (1) tune data_sink_redis_pool_size + max_inflight_publish to absorb opening-bell volume; (2) add Prometheus alert on dropped_backpressure rate; (3) optionally persist drops to disk-backed queue.

findings.title: Random event_id in fast_wrap_streaming_event breaks gateway-level dedup
findings.description: fast_wrap_streaming_event uses os.urandom(16).hex() for event_id while wrap_event computes BLAKE2b hash. Same upstream event wrapped twice produces two distinct envelopes. Gateway dedup at uw_poller relies on content-derived IDs.
findings.recommendation: Pick ONE contract. Preferred: cheap content hash (xxhash/fnv1a sub-microsecond). Alternative: rename function to make random-id semantics explicit and verify Heber re-derives dedup.

findings.title: ProviderRegistry tolerates init failure → degraded healthy gateway
findings.description: Per-provider try/except in load_from_config + _load_provider lets gateway boot with missing providers. /health stays 200; runtime calls fail with confusing 'Provider access denied'.
findings.evidence: registry.py:40 'except Exception as e: logger.error(...)' continues loop
findings.recommendation: Add 'required: true|false' per provider in providers.yaml. In non-debug mode, fail startup if a required provider fails to initialize.

findings.title: Silent error swallowing pattern in envelope/middleware data path
findings.description: Two instances: wrap_event returns 'minimal fallback envelope' on exception; EventEnvelopeMiddleware returns original body on wrap exception. Both convert errors into corrupt-but-routable data — worse than failures for a data pipeline.
findings.evidence: envelope.py:403 'except Exception as e: ... return {minimal envelope with quality_flags=["error"]}'; middleware.py:954 'except Exception as e: logger.warning(...); await send(initial_message); await send({body})'
findings.recommendation: Remove broad excepts. Guard specific operations only. Optional GATEWAY_STRICT_ENVELOPES=true feature flag for fail-fast environments.

findings.title: Permissive empty-list permissions + cache scoping = cross-tenant data leak
findings.description: Empty permissions.providers/feeds returns True (all-access). Cache scope keyed by permissions_hash means two empty-permission clients share cache entries. Concrete cross-tenant leak.
findings.evidence: websocket.py:663 'if not allowed: return True'; middleware.py:599 'cache_key = (...providers, feeds, ...)'; same hash → same cache scope
findings.recommendation: (1) Salt permissions_hash with client.id (always-distinct cache scope). (2) Add gateway audit-clients CLI to surface clients with empty permissions.

findings.title: EventEnvelopeMiddleware fully buffers response body, breaking streaming
findings.description: buffering_send accumulates body_chunks until more_body=False. No content-type exclusion for NDJSON/SSE (only CacheMiddleware excludes them). Per-request memory floor 512KB; double-buffering with cache layer.
findings.evidence: middleware.py:826 'body_chunks.append(message.get("body", b""))'; line 818 cacheability check excludes streaming types but envelope wrap does not
findings.recommendation: Add NDJSON/SSE content-type exclusion. Consider stream-wrapping for non-streaming JSON (emit envelope frame, stream payload, close).

findings.title: API key prefix (10 chars) logged on auth failure
findings.description: On invalid key, logs api_key[:10] + '...' as key_prefix. Keys begin with 'gw_' leaving 7 random chars in the prefix. Logged to file AND audit trail (compliance disclosure).
findings.evidence: auth.py:118 'key_preview = api_key[:10] + "..." if len(api_key) > 10 else api_key' logged via logger.warning + audit.auth_failure
findings.recommendation: Replace with sha256(key)[:8] fingerprint. Same correlation ability, zero plaintext leakage.

findings.title: Debug-mode CORS = '*' + credentials — used in docker-compose
findings.description: allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True is forbidden by CORS spec. Default Docker compose sets GATEWAY_DEBUG=true, so the violating combination runs in the development container.
findings.recommendation: In debug, use specific localhost origins. Add startup assertion that fails if '*' + credentials.

findings.title: WebSocket message size validation AFTER full receive — memory amplification
findings.description: _message_loop receives the full message before checking len > max_bytes. Starlette WS has no default frame cap. 100MB attack frames OOM the process; handler 'continue's allowing repeats on same connection.
findings.recommendation: Set uvicorn --ws-max-size cap. On oversize, close 1009 instead of continuing.

findings.title: Stream-sink shutdown drain timeout (2s) shorter than publish timeout (5s)
findings.description: _drain_stream_sink_publish_tasks(timeout_seconds=2.0) cancels in-flight publishes before they complete. Cancelled publishes don't re-enter _failed_buffer; events lost.
findings.evidence: main.py:250 'async def _drain_stream_sink_publish_tasks(timeout_seconds: float = 2.0)' vs redis_sink default timeout 5.0
findings.recommendation: Set drain timeout >= operation_timeout_seconds. Two-pass drain (graceful then forced).

findings.title: CI perf-gate erosion masks real regressions
findings.description: Recent 5 commits all relax perf budgets to keep CI green. Production performance trends are unknown because no separate prod baseline exists.
findings.evidence: Commit messages: 'raise perf baselines to CI runner reality', 'extend static merge to cover baselines', 'relax path-normalization perf budget'
findings.recommendation: Split CI vs prod perf gates. Audit perf_baseline.json git history. Weekly review of prod baseline trend lines.

findings.title: X-Forwarded-For first-IP trust → spoofable through untrusted proxy chain
findings.description: _get_client_ip returns leftmost XFF value when trust_proxy_headers=True. Per-IP rate limit (1000/min) and IP block list bypassable.
findings.recommendation: Walk XFF rightmost; require trusted_proxy_cidrs allowlist. Default to socket peer otherwise.

findings.title: Plaintext API keys in clients.yaml supported and preferred
findings.description: Authenticator checks plaintext keys before hashed. clients.yaml is committed (symlinked); plaintext production keys are one mistake from leaking.
findings.recommendation: Log warning when plaintext used in non-debug mode. Roadmap to deprecate plaintext fully.

findings.title: Failed-event buffer in memory; lost on process death
findings.description: 10K-event in-memory deque. close() does NOT drain. SIGKILL/OOM/container restart loses up to 10K events.
findings.evidence: redis_sink.py:97 'self._failed_buffer: deque[tuple[str, bytes]] = deque(maxlen=FAILED_EVENT_BUFFER_CAPACITY)'; close() at line 632 does not call _drain_buffer
findings.recommendation: Drain buffer in close(). For higher tier: persist to disk on shutdown, restore on boot.

findings.title: Redis pool size silently capped at 64
findings.description: max(1, min(64, int(pool_size))) — operator value silently overridden. Contributing factor to F-01 (backpressure).
findings.recommendation: Log warning when caller exceeds cap. Move cap into Settings validation.
